execution_record.transaction_error: TransactionError: CP01R2 target process failed with return code 1

failure_evidence.exception_message: cannot access local variable 'classification' where it is not associated with a value
failure_evidence.failing_target_callsite: legacy._finalize(entries, internal_states, internal_details, independent_records, primary, model, sector, thresholds)
failure_evidence.source_root_cause: CP01R2 stores an internal terminal state for every normally completed mesh stage, including progress-continuation states that are not local roots. The inherited CP01R1 finalizer assigns per-seed classification inside the internal-state branch only when has_n96_root is true. Therefore an N=96 terminal state without a local root leaves classification unbound and crashes finalization.

control_flow_findings.basis: The observed traceback enters legacy._finalize from the post-loop callsite. Under the frozen target source, any uncaught per-entry exception would have exited before this call; normal and StageTimeout paths append an entry before the next schedule item.
control_flow_findings.basis_for_n96_inference: Unbound classification is reachable only when n96_key exists in internal_states while has_n96_root is false.

D6-B01.title: CP01R2 progress-state semantics are incompatible with the inherited CP01R1 finalizer
D6-B01.required_closure: Replace or wrap finalization so every per-seed path deterministically assigns classification when an N=96 internal state exists but is not a local root. Add deterministic fixtures for progress state without local root, local root rejected by QA, accepted local root, missing N=96 state, and timeout paths. Do not alter physical equations, thresholds, seeds, meshes or ETRN-01 semantics.

D6-B02.title: No durable per-entry write-ahead closure exists before finalization
D6-B02.required_closure: Persist each completed/timed-out schedule record and its required diagnostic/provenance payload atomically before advancing to the next entry, with a deterministic immutable checkpoint manifest. Finalization must consume the persisted checkpoint set so a packaging/finalizer exception cannot erase the 35-entry numerical record.
